property: This gate admits a cookie only when it is a '__Host-' cookie with Secure set, Path=/, HttpOnly set, and no Domain attribute at all.
reference_fix: cookie.name.startswith("__Host-") and cookie.secure and cookie.path == "/" and cookie.domain is None and cookie.http_only
alternate_fixes: cookie.domain is None and cookie.http_only and cookie.path == "/" and cookie.secure and cookie.name.startswith("__Host-")
cookie.name[:7] == "__Host-" and cookie.secure and cookie.path == "/" and cookie.http_only and cookie.domain is None
all((cookie.name.startswith("__Host-"), cookie.secure, cookie.http_only, cookie.path == "/", cookie.domain is None))

seeded_bad.expression: cookie.name.startswith("__Host-") and cookie.secure and cookie.path == "/" and cookie.domain is None and cookie.http_only and cookie.name != "__Host-sid"
seeded_bad.why: Blocks the exact cookie name from the PoC, so the compliant '__Host-sid' cookie the application must set is refused too.
Checks the prefix, Secure and Path but not the Domain or HttpOnly obligations, so a __Host- cookie with Domain set is admitted.
Refuses every cookie, so no legitimate policy-compliant cookie can be set.

seeded_bad.expression: True and (cookie.name.startswith("__Host-") and cookie.secure and cookie.http_only)
seeded_bad.why: Wraps a prefix/flag check in 'True and (...)', leaving both the Domain and Path obligations unchecked.

polarity.fact: A '__Host-' cookie must carry no Domain attribute, so the domain must be absent (None); a present Domain attribute must never be admitted.
